title: Conversion Tracking: How to Know Which Ads Bring Enquiries
desc: Conversion tracking shows which ads and keywords lead to enquiries, not just clicks. Learn what to track and how to check that it works.
answer: Conversion tracking records the actions that matter to your business, such as form submissions or WhatsApp clicks, and links them to the ad that brought the visitor. Without it you only see clicks and cannot tell which campaigns bring real enquiries.
body: A conversion is an action you want a visitor to take. For a service business it is usually a form submission, a WhatsApp click or a phone call. For an online shop it is a purchase.
What to track for most small businesses
Phone number clicks, if you show one.
Purchases or add-to-cart actions for online shops.
Google Ads conversion tracking, with the Google tag, for Google campaigns.
Google Analytics 4 to see how visitors move through your site.
Meta Pixel, and where possible the Conversions API, for Facebook and Instagram campaigns.

Test every action yourself. Submit the form, click the WhatsApp button, then confirm the event appears in the platform. Google Tag Assistant and the Meta Pixel Helper browser extension help with this. Platform steps change, so check the current official guides when you set it up.
Never testing after a website update.
Not telling the platform which action is the real goal.
Tell visitors what you track in a privacy page, and follow each platform's rules for personal data.
faq: It shows which keywords, ads and audiences bring enquiries, so you can spend more on what works and stop what does not.
Yes. A click on a WhatsApp button can be recorded as an event. It shows interest, though not whether the chat became a sale.
It is not required for ads to run, but it helps you understand visitor behaviour beyond the ad platform.
